source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.6 (PDF 148, printed 145).

blocks.text: Jaise pichhle hisse mein dekha, data ka visualization numbers ko aasan charts aur graphs mein badal kar bohat sari maloomat samajhne mein madad deta hai. Is hisse mein woh tools dekhenge jin se yeh visualizations bante hain, aur qadam ba qadam seekhenge ke inhein kaise banayein aur samjhein.

Data visualization ke bohat se tools hain, lekin sab se aasan woh hain jo aap shayad pehle se jaante hain, jaise Microsoft Excel aur Google Sheets. Yeh aam dastiyab hain aur charts, graphs aur doosri tasveeri shakalein banane ke seedhe tareeqe dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Data visualization ke liye aam taur par kaunsa tool istemal hota hai: MS Excel, Python (Matplotlib), Tableau, ya yeh sab? (MCQ 4)

items: Visualization tools: Excel aur Google Sheets (sab se aasan); Python Matplotlib aur Tableau bhi.
